displayName: OCI-PCI-004: PCI-DSS — Missing MFA for CDE Access
description:
Detects access to cardholder data environment without required multi-factor authentication violating PCI-DSS Requirement 8

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: pci-dss — missing mfa for cde access

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_pci_004", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%pci%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%dss%') AND "value" > 0
